mechanism: Establish one bounded subject-space relationship with a clearly hidden offscreen region and progressively tighten from body-scale reorientation to micro-reaction without revealing a source. The creator states that sound supplies spatial information, while local ASR proves narration but not exact cue direction or synchronization; therefore each new transfer must explicitly design its own directional offscreen cues rather than treating source cue timing as observed fact. End on a held response, residual instrument state or blackout.

invariants.rule: Establish one reaction subject and one bounded offscreen region without showing a source.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unbounded or already visible source removes the suspense mechanism.

invariants.rule: For each new instance, explicitly design a directional offscreen cue for a visible reorientation while the subject stays in the same bounded area; source cue timing remains inferred.
invariants.purpose: Connects newly authored unseen space to observable behavior without overclaiming source synchronization.
invariants.ablation_failure: Large relocation or an unspecified cue breaks localization continuity.

invariants.rule: Tighten the camera after each visible reorientation and reduce motion from body turn to gaze or facial adjustment.
invariants.purpose: Converts spatial suspense into performance detail using directly visible source structure.

invariants.rule: Keep the cue source outside every frame and avoid explanatory inserts.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the audience's active spatial inference.
invariants.ablation_failure: Showing the source converts suspense into ordinary coverage.

invariants.rule: End on a held reaction, residual instrument state or blackout without a source reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: A final reveal cancels the central withholding rule.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman, keys and dim residential corridor
the source wall-dominant foreground and single wall lamp
the source exact rear silhouette to tight face order
the source implied monster, voice, whisper and knock wording
the source black ending and exact corridor reaction staging

instantiations.concept: In an original orbital greenhouse, one maintenance technician at a fixed sensor bench hears designed pressure ticks migrate through overhead irrigation pipes. She reorients from ceiling manifold to side vent while the camera tightens from medium to eye-and-ear profile; a fixed gauge needle twitches once, the source remains unseen and the chamber falls to black.
